title: OpenClaw file-tool capability diagnostic
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';Write-Output '=== PRIOR 057A RESULT ===';$p='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/openclaw-tool-proof.txt';Write-Output ('TARGET_EXISTS='+(Test-Path $p));Write-Output '=== AGENT HELP ===';& openclaw.cmd agent --help 2>&1|ForEach-Object{Write-Output $_};Write-Output ('AGENT_HELP_EXIT='+$LASTEXITCODE);Write-Output '=== OPENCLAW CONFIG ===';$cfg=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw/openclaw.json';if(Test-Path $cfg){Get-Content $cfg -Raw|Write-Output}else{Write-Output 'CONFIG_MISSING'};Write-Output '=== AGENT TOOL INTROSPECTION ===';$prompt='Report only the names of local tools/capabilities you can actually invoke in this session for filesystem or shell execution.
